units.source_text: 但是，她的话里没有肉感。

en.t: But there was no sensuality in her words.

units.source_text: 在我看来，鞠子像游戏时离开了伙伴的孩子，

en.t: To my eyes, Mariko seemed like a child who had left her playmates in the middle of a game,

units.source_text: 独自在我的肉体和她的肉体都没有关联的地方做着精神上的放荡。

en.t: indulging alone in a spiritual debauchery in a place unrelated to either my body or hers.

units.source_text: 鞠子身穿浅绿色的衬衫，配黄色格子。

en.t: Mariko wore a pale green shirt with a yellow check pattern.

units.source_text: 大概是向朋友借来闹着玩的吧，她的两只手，只有拇指甲染上了指甲油。

en.t: Perhaps she had borrowed it from a friend for fun; on both her hands, only the thumbnails were painted with nail polish.
